title.zh: 开始实践：准备运行环境与文件
title.en: Getting Started: Your Environment and Files

standfirst.zh: 把一份输入变成可以观察和分析的分子轨迹，需要哪些程序？从终端和文件夹开始，准备两套课程共用的运行环境。
standfirst.en: What turns an input file into a molecular trajectory you can inspect and analyse? Start with terminals and folders, then prepare the environment shared by both courses.

title.zh: 先认识计算中的三个角色
title.en: Three roles in a simulation

title.zh: 打开正确的终端，选好工作目录
title.en: Choose a terminal and workspace

title.zh: 把源代码变成可运行的引擎
title.en: Build the simulation engines

title.zh: 给数据分析准备自己的工具箱
title.en: Prepare the analysis environment

title.zh: 从参考数据走到自己的一次运行
title.en: From reference data to your own run

title.zh: 顺着报错找到需要补齐的一步
title.en: Use an error message to find the next step

title.zh: 为配体和聚合物准备建模工具
title.en: Prepare tools for ligands and polymers

title.zh: 分子模拟能告诉我们什么
title.en: What Molecular Simulation Can Tell Us

standfirst.zh: 从一盒水出发，理解模型怎样生成运动，运动怎样形成可测量的密度，以及一条曲线怎样回答一个具体的科学问题。
standfirst.en: Start with a box of water to understand how a model produces motion, how motion connects to measurable density, and how a curve answers a specific scientific question.

title.zh: 从一杯水开始，把问题缩小到分子能回答的范围
title.en: Start with a glass of water and a question molecules can answer

title.zh: 从“看不见的运动”到可以检验的液体模型
title.en: Turning invisible motion into a testable model of a liquid

title.zh: 一盒“水”在计算机里究竟由什么组成
title.en: What the computational box of water actually contains

title.zh: 为什么位置可以一步一步算出来
title.en: Why the next position can be calculated

title.zh: 密度怎样把许多分子的运动连到日常测量
title.en: How density connects molecular motion to an everyday measurement

title.zh: 把真实记录变成一张能解释的图
title.en: Turn the recorded data into a figure you can explain

title.zh: 动画里发生了什么，统计图又多告诉了什么
title.en: What an animation shows, and what statistics add

title.zh: 怎样把一个好奇心变成可计算的问题
title.en: Turn curiosity into a calculable research question

title.zh: 从文件到轨迹：准备一次分子模拟
title.en: From Files to Trajectories: Preparing a Simulation

standfirst.zh: 打开水盒的坐标、拓扑与参数，理解它们如何组成一次运行，再用完整程序核对分子身份、位点数量和盒子几何。
standfirst.en: Open the water box coordinates, topology, and parameters, understand how they define a run, and inspect molecular identities, site counts, and box geometry with a complete program.

title.zh: 让一份计算在另一台电脑上仍然说得清楚
title.en: Make a calculation understandable on another computer

title.zh: 科学为什么需要可以交换的原子坐标
title.en: Why science needs exchangeable atomic coordinates

title.zh: 读懂一行坐标：身份、位置与长度单位
title.en: Read a coordinate line: identity, position, and length units

title.zh: 拓扑把坐标上的名字变成一个物理模型
title.en: A topology turns names and positions into a physical model

title.zh: 参数文件描述一次观察怎样进行
title.en: Run parameters describe how an observation is performed

title.zh: 预处理、运行与续算，三个动作怎样接起来
title.en: Connect preprocessing, running, and continuation

title.zh: 用一段完整程序检查水盒的身份与几何
title.en: Use a complete program to inspect the water box

title.zh: 把一套输入整理成可以继续研究的起点
title.en: Organize an input set that can support further research

title.zh: 一盒水的第一场模拟
title.en: A First Simulation of a Box of Water

standfirst.zh: 让水经过几何整理、温度调整与体积调整，再从真实的力、能量和密度记录理解每一步的作用。
standfirst.en: Prepare water geometry, temperature, and volume, then use actual force, energy, and density records to understand what each stage accomplishes.

title.zh: 让水动起来之前，先给它一个合适的起点
title.en: Give the water a suitable starting point before it moves

title.zh: 最小化在整理几何，不是在等待水冷却
title.en: Minimization prepares geometry rather than waiting for water to cool

title.zh: 控温要保留热涨落，不能只追求一条平直曲线
title.en: Temperature control must preserve thermal fluctuations

title.zh: 让体积响应压力，水才有机会选择自己的密度
title.en: Allow volume to respond so water can establish its density

title.zh: 完整运行脚本怎样把阶段连接起来
title.en: How the complete script connects the stages

title.zh: 把分阶段记录画在合适的坐标轴上
title.en: Plot each stage on an axis with the right meaning

title.zh: “稳定”需要说明稳定的是哪一种观察
title.en: Specify which observation is stable

title.zh: 从第一次运行走向有目的的比较
title.en: Move from a first run to a purposeful comparison

title.zh: 分子为什么这样运动：力场、时间步与边界
title.en: Why Molecules Move: Force Fields, Time Steps and Boundaries

standfirst.zh: 从吸引和排斥到周期空间，再用同一盒水的1飞秒与2飞秒计算分开观察快速波动和缓慢漂移。
standfirst.en: Connect attraction, repulsion, and periodic space, then compare fast fluctuations and slow drift in actual 1 fs and 2 fs water calculations.

title.zh: 同一杯水，可以有不同的计算描述
title.en: The same water can have different computational descriptions

title.zh: 从吸引和排斥理解力场里的数字
title.en: Read force-field parameters through attraction and repulsion

title.zh: 每一步走多远，取决于需要追踪多快的运动
title.en: Choose a step that resolves the motions retained in the model

title.zh: 走出盒子边缘，为什么会从另一边回来
title.en: Why does a molecule leaving one edge return at the other?

title.zh: 近邻逐个计算，远处的电荷怎样处理
title.en: Calculate neighbours directly and handle distant charges collectively

title.zh: 让两条分支从同一个状态出发
title.en: Start both branches from the same prepared state

title.zh: 快速波动变小，为什么缓慢漂移仍可能更大
title.en: Smaller fast fluctuations can coexist with greater slow drift

title.zh: 把数值检查带到真正的分子问题里
title.en: Carry numerical checks into a molecular research question

title.zh: 从实验结构到可计算的蛋白质
title.en: From an experimental structure to a protein model

standfirst.zh: 从泛素的分子标签功能出发，读懂序列、坐标与实验记录，明确氢、末端和电荷，再把同一个分子交给GROMACS。
standfirst.en: Start with ubiquitin's role as a molecular tag, read its sequence and structural records, and define hydrogens, termini, and charges before building the GROMACS model.

title.zh: 从细胞里的分子标签说起
title.en: Begin with a molecular tag inside the cell

title.zh: 读懂一条蛋白质链的化学语言
title.en: Read the chemical language of a protein chain

title.zh: 从序列到立体结构：实验怎样补齐这张图
title.en: How experiments connected sequence with three-dimensional structure

title.zh: 把1UBQ中的每一类记录读清楚
title.en: Read the different records in 1UBQ

title.zh: 选择保留什么，也是在选择研究对象
title.en: Choosing what to retain defines the object being studied

title.zh: 氢的位置、链的两端和电荷怎样决定
title.en: Choose hydrogen positions, terminal groups, and charges

title.zh: 完整示例：从结构检查到生成拓扑
title.en: A complete example: inspect the structure and generate the topology

title.zh: 把准备好的模型接到真正的科学问题上
title.en: Connect the prepared model to a scientific question

title.zh: 把蛋白质放进水里：拓扑、溶剂与离子
title.en: Putting a protein in water: topology, solvent, and ions

standfirst.zh: 从泛素的水环境出发，读懂周期晶胞、三位点水和盐的整数计数，逐步建立组成明确的溶液。
standfirst.en: Build a defined ubiquitin solution while connecting periodic geometry, three-site water, and integer ion counts to their physical meaning.

title.zh: 水为什么必须进入我们的模型
title.en: Why water belongs in the model

title.zh: 从盐溶液导电到计算中的带电粒子
title.en: From conducting salt solutions to charged particles

title.zh: 坐标告诉我们在哪里，拓扑告诉我们是什么
title.en: Coordinates describe positions; topology defines the species

title.zh: 用周期晶胞给蛋白质留出水的空间
title.en: Leaving room for water with a periodic cell

title.zh: 一盒盐水里究竟有多少盐
title.en: How much salt is in this small box?

title.zh: 把建盒、加水和加盐连成可重复的操作
title.en: A reproducible sequence for the cell, solvent, and ions

title.zh: 从真实输出中核对组成与浓度
title.en: Checking composition and concentration in the actual output

title.zh: 让溶液条件与研究问题保持一致
title.en: Matching solution conditions to the research question

title.zh: 从准备到采样：让蛋白质适应水环境
title.en: From preparation to sampling: adapting a protein to water

standfirst.zh: 用位置限制、检查点与真实温压曲线，理解几何松弛、环境调整和蛋白质运动各自需要什么。
standfirst.en: Use restraints, checkpoints, and actual temperature and pressure records to distinguish geometrical relaxation, environmental adjustment, and protein motion.

title.zh: 让刚刚装好的分子系统开始运动
title.en: Starting the motion of a newly assembled system

title.zh: 最低点附近仍然有生命分子的运动
title.en: Molecules still move around an energy minimum

title.zh: 先松开过近接触，再给系统真实的时间
title.en: Relax close contacts before assigning physical time

title.zh: 位置限制像弹簧，键长约束像固定连接
title.en: Position restraints act like springs; constraints fix geometry

title.zh: 温度、压力与体积怎样共同准备
title.en: Preparing temperature, pressure, and volume together

title.zh: 把状态接下去，而不是在每段重新开始
title.en: Continue the state rather than restart it at every stage

title.zh: 让四幅图回答四个具体问题
title.en: Four panels answer four specific questions

title.zh: 根据要测的现象决定准备是否充分
title.en: Let the observable determine what sufficient preparation means

title.zh: 从轨迹读懂蛋白质的运动
title.en: Reading protein motion from a trajectory

standfirst.zh: 把整体移动、内部形变和局部波动分开，再用一段真实泛素轨迹理解RMSD、回转半径与RMSF。
standfirst.en: Separate overall motion, internal deformation, and local fluctuations, then read RMSD, radius of gyration, and RMSF from an actual ubiquitin trajectory.

title.zh: 一段分子电影，三种不同的问题
title.en: One molecular movie, three different questions

title.zh: 先把跨过边界的蛋白质接回来
title.en: Reconstruct the protein across periodic boundaries

title.zh: 让两幅结构站在同一个坐标系里
title.en: Place two structures in a common coordinate frame

title.zh: RMSD：相对一幅参考结构改变了多少
title.en: RMSD: how far a structure has moved from a reference

title.zh: 回转半径：质量分布在多大的范围里
title.en: Radius of gyration: the size of a mass distribution

title.zh: RMSF：哪些位置在自己的平均位置附近移动
title.en: RMSF: motion around each position’s own time average

title.zh: 用完整程序把轨迹变成可读的图
title.en: Turn the trajectory into readable figures with complete programs

title.zh: 把三种读数放回同一段运动
title.en: Bring the three measurements back to the same motion

title.zh: 一条曲线有多可靠：重复、相关与误差
title.en: How Reliable Is a Curve? Replicates, Correlation and Error

standfirst.zh: 用三条泛素轨迹区分真实涨落、时间相关与平均值的不确定性，让下一次计算补充需要的信息。
standfirst.en: Use three ubiquitin trajectories to separate fluctuations, temporal correlation, and uncertainty in an average, then plan the next sampling step.

title.zh: 多算几千帧，为什么还要问结果有多可靠
title.en: Why thousands of saved frames still need a reliability check

title.zh: 连续运动留下记忆：分块思想从哪里来
title.en: Continuous motion retains memory: the origin of blocking

title.zh: 把重复设计好，再开始比较
title.en: Design the repetitions before comparing them

title.zh: 平均值、涨落宽度和累计曲线分别说明什么
title.en: What means, fluctuation widths, and cumulative curves describe

title.zh: 相隔多久，两次观察才带来不同的信息
title.en: How far apart must observations be to add different information?

title.zh: 把相邻时刻合成一块，看看误差怎样改变
title.en: Combine neighbouring times and watch the error estimate change

title.zh: 三条轨迹之间的差异，怎样进入结论
title.en: How differences between trajectories enter a conclusion

title.zh: 让保存频率、运行时长和重复各有任务
title.en: Give output frequency, run duration, and replication separate jobs

title.zh: 蛋白质与小分子怎样相遇
title.en: Simulating a Protein and a Small Molecule

standfirst.zh: 从实验结合结构建立蛋白质—配体模型，读懂口袋中的位移、接触与方向。
standfirst.en: Build a protein–ligand model from an experimental bound structure and interpret displacement, contacts, and orientation inside its pocket.

title.zh: 从一个已经结合的口袋，理解分子识别
title.en: Understanding molecular recognition from an occupied pocket

title.zh: 把结构里的每一种身份认清
title.en: Establishing the identity of every component

title.zh: 一套相互作用规则怎样容纳蛋白质和配体
title.en: One interaction model for a protein and its ligand

title.zh: 把化学身份、坐标顺序和拓扑接在一起
title.en: Connecting chemical identity, coordinate order, and topology

title.zh: 让口袋和溶液共同调整，再解除位置限制
title.en: Relaxing the pocket and solution before releasing restraints

title.zh: 让每一个“接触”都有明确的测量方法
title.en: Giving every contact a precise measurement

title.zh: 把轨迹中的局部变化画出来
title.en: Visualizing local changes in the recorded trajectory

title.zh: 从局部运动走向结合问题的研究设计
title.en: Designing the next study beyond local motion

title.zh: 双螺旋在溶液里怎样运动
title.en: How a Double Helix Moves in Solution

standfirst.zh: 从碱基配对、水和离子出发，运行周期DNA模型，观察双螺旋中持续发生的局部运动。
standfirst.en: Start with base pairing, water, and ions; run a periodic DNA model and measure the local motion within its double helix.

title.zh: 从遗传分子到可设计的材料
title.en: From genetic molecule to designed material

title.zh: 衍射图为什么改变了对DNA的理解
title.en: How diffraction changed the picture of DNA

title.zh: 沿着一对碱基读懂分子模型
title.en: Reading the model through one base pair

title.zh: 周期连接给双螺旋施加了什么条件
title.en: What periodic connectivity means for a helix

title.zh: 运行一段有明确起点的DNA轨迹
title.en: Running a DNA trajectory from a defined state

title.zh: 把局部运动拆成距离、方向与倾斜
title.en: Resolving local motion into distance, direction, and tilt

title.zh: 把时间轨迹读成分布和环境变化
title.en: Reading distributions and environmental changes

title.zh: 让模型选择对应生物学问题
title.en: Matching the model to the biological question

title.zh: 糖的立体形状与身边的水
title.en: Sugar Shape and the Water Around It

standfirst.zh: 用海藻糖的全原子轨迹理解糖苷键转动、圆周统计和水化层，把化学身份、空间构象与材料问题连起来。
standfirst.en: Use an atomistic trehalose trajectory to understand glycosidic rotation, circular statistics, and hydration, connecting chemical identity to molecular shape and materials questions.

title.zh: 糖为什么值得单独建立模型
title.en: Why sugars deserve their own molecular models

title.zh: 从费歇尔的糖到分子的立体身份
title.en: From Fischer’s sugars to molecular identity

title.zh: 把两个糖环连接成海藻糖
title.en: Connecting two glucose rings into trehalose

title.zh: 参数怎样完整地进入GROMACS
title.en: Carrying the complete parameters into GROMACS

title.zh: 让糖和水一起运动
title.en: Letting the sugar and its water move together

title.zh: 沿着圆周理解糖苷键的转动
title.en: Understanding glycosidic rotation on a circle

title.zh: 糖周围的水应该怎样数
title.en: How to count the water around a sugar

title.zh: 从一个双糖走向糖链材料
title.en: From one disaccharide to glycan materials

title.zh: 膜怎样组织分子：脂质与界面
title.en: How Membranes Organize Molecules: Lipids and Interfaces

standfirst.zh: 从两层脂质的方向出发，读取膜蛋白周围的面积、厚度、密度与分子取向。
standfirst.en: Start with the two lipid leaflets and read area, thickness, density and molecular orientation around a membrane protein.

title.zh: 一层薄膜，怎样同时隔开水和组织分子
title.en: How can a thin membrane separate water and organize molecules?

title.zh: 从铺开的脂质，到会流动的分子拼图
title.en: From spread-out lipids to a moving molecular mosaic

title.zh: 认识这片膜：通道、脂质、水和离子
title.en: Meet the system: channel, lipids, water and ions

title.zh: 膜有两个方向，盒子也要分别调整
title.en: A membrane has two kinds of direction

title.zh: 先找到两层，再定义面积和厚度
title.en: Find the leaflets before defining area and thickness

title.zh: 沿膜切薄片，看见水和脂质怎样分层
title.en: Slice the membrane to reveal molecular layering

title.zh: 尾链怎样排列，为什么一个角度还不够
title.en: How do the tails orient, and what does one angle leave out?

title.zh: 让结构图、曲线和完整代码回答同一个问题
title.en: Connect the structure, curves and complete analysis

title.zh: 聚合物在水中伸展还是蜷缩
title.en: How Polymers Extend and Coil in Water

standfirst.zh: 从羟基端基 PEG 的连接方式出发，生成原子模型，再用两条真实轨迹读懂链的尺寸、构象分布与水化。
standfirst.en: Build hydroxyl-ended PEG from its chemical connectivity, then use two recorded trajectories to understand chain dimensions, conformational distributions, and hydration.

title.zh: 一条柔软的链，究竟有多大
title.en: How large is a flexible chain?

title.zh: 从连接方式理解柔性：为什么长分子会蜷曲
title.en: Connectivity and flexibility: why a long molecule coils

title.zh: 把重复单元和端基写对，再生成分子
title.en: Specify the repeat units and ends before building the molecule

title.zh: 让同一条链经历两段独立的运动
title.en: Give the same chain two independent motion histories

title.zh: 回转半径与端到端距离：同一条链的两把尺子
title.en: Radius of gyration and end-to-end distance: two rulers for one chain

title.zh: 把许多形状放在一起，平均值才有含义
title.en: An average acquires meaning from many shapes

title.zh: 水化不是在链外面套一个固定的壳
title.en: Hydration is a changing neighborhood

title.zh: 从完整分析程序走向下一次比较
title.en: Use the complete analysis to design the next comparison

title.zh: 脂质如何自己排成一层膜
title.en: How Lipids Assemble into a Membrane

standfirst.zh: 把原子细节汇总为化学珠子，观察DSPC的真实自组装，并用叶片面积、密度和取向理解双层结构。
standfirst.en: Represent chemical fragments as beads, follow recorded DSPC self-assembly, and interpret the bilayer through leaflet area, density, and orientation.

title.zh: 一层膜怎样从散开的分子中出现
title.en: How a membrane emerges from dispersed molecules

title.zh: 从原子到珠子：保留什么，平均什么
title.en: From atoms to beads: what is retained and averaged

title.zh: 让参数文件与分子组成相互对应
title.en: Match parameter files to molecular composition

title.zh: 观察自组装：从位置变化找到共同方向
title.en: Read assembly through positions and collective orientation

title.zh: 把膜转正，让横向面积能够独立调整
title.en: Rotate the membrane and release its lateral area

title.zh: 一片膜，两种每脂质面积
title.en: One membrane and two areas per lipid

title.zh: 用密度和取向读懂膜的内部
title.en: Read the membrane interior through density and orientation

title.zh: 把自组装记录变成可继续研究的模型
title.en: Turn an assembly record into a model for further study

title.zh: 给膜接上聚合物：从稀疏线团到拥挤外衣
title.en: Grafting Polymers onto a Membrane

standfirst.zh: 比较两种PEG接枝比例，用真实轨迹理解表面密度、质量分布、末端高度与初始构象的影响。
standfirst.en: Compare two PEG grafting fractions through recorded surface densities, mass distributions, terminal heights, and preparation histories.

title.zh: 给脂质膜穿上一层会运动的外衣
title.en: A moving polymer coat on a lipid membrane

title.zh: 从脂质载体实验到可以构建的分子外衣
title.en: From lipid-carrier experiments to molecular construction

title.zh: 认清一个接枝分子：珠子、质量和电荷
title.en: Identify one grafted molecule: beads, mass, and charge

title.zh: 把链接到正确的脂质上
title.en: Connect each chain to the correct lipid

title.zh: 让水、离子、链和膜一起松弛
title.en: Relax the water, ions, polymers, and membrane together
